entities.name: Estatuto Orgânico de Macau
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Organic Statute of Macau was a Portuguese organic law that provided for government in Portuguese Macau. Approved on 17 February 1976, the Portuguese legislation also reclassified Macau as a "Chinese territory under Portuguese administration".
